intro: Our Adria dressing table brings beauty to your daily rituals. With lasting materials and thoughtful details, it’s where you prepare for the world—and wind down from it.

features.title: Reflects care and quality
features.text: A 4mm fixed mirror rests securely in a sleek, sturdy panel—that not only enhances your space but ensures you look and feel your best before stepping out.

features.title: Hardware that won’t let you down
features.text: We use trusted components—rollers, hinges, and dowels—ensuring smooth operation and lasting quality.

features.title: Built to glide, not grind
features.text: Both drawer opens with ease thanks to high-quality hardware—bringing quiet confidence to your morning and night routines.

features.title: Handles that don’t try too hard
features.text: Sleek, linear handles sit flush against the front—keeping the look clean while offering a confident grip.

features.title: Moves with your life
features.text: With knockdown construction, our dresser is easy to transport and assemble—supporting you through every move and milestone.

care: Wipe with soft thick cloth. Avoid using bleach when washing upholstery. Do not keep hot items directly on a furniture surface; instead use a hot pad or coasters. To protect your furniture from fading, avoid keeping your furniture next to windows and other places where it can be exposed to direct sunlight. Cleaning your furniture items regularly will help you maintain them for a long time.
